notes.title: SPOOKWARE Embarks on the 'Big Adventure Event'!
notes.content:
Greetings folks!
Hitcents is hosting the exciting 'Big Adventure Event' on Steam from January 20th-24th, 2022. It's a grand celebration of titles that focus on escapades, zany exploits, and well, adventures! There'll be many games coming along for the ride, showcasing their stuff through broadcasts, sales, demos, and more!

How could the brothers say no to an opportunity like that? Be sure to pick up SPOOKWARE during the event! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574250/SPOOKWARE/

And as always, if you want to keep up with the comings, goings, and haunts happening at DreadXP, follow us on our socials!

notes.title: Dust Off Your Necronomicon and Pick up some Flowers!
notes.content:
Great news, humans and sunken city inhabitants! Sucker for Love: Prelude is out now on Steam! Enjoy an unforgettable experience with the type of gal you just can't stop thinking of. 

From the store page itself:
Sucker for Love is a romantic visual novel with a dark twist. It's said that the heart and brain are often at odds, and SfL puts that to the test. As you woo this otherworldly beauty, try to keep your mind from spiraling into maddening insanity! Recite the incantations for the perfect date and stave off oblivion by:

 Performing dangerous rituals
 Keeping your possessive eldritch date happy
 Escaping from the horrors you unleash upon yourself


*Seriously I can't get her out of my head. Please send help.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820740/Sucker_for_Love_Prelude/

And don't forget to wishlist the page for Sucker for Love: First Date, coming early next year! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574270/Sucker_for_Love_First_Date/
